name: openrouter-balance
description: Your OpenRouter credit above the prompt: the balance with a gauge, today's spend and where the money mostly went. /openrouter-balance shows the breakdown.

apiKey.title: OpenRouter key
apiKey.description: A management key (openrouter.ai → Settings → Management keys) shows the account balance and spend by model; a regular API key shows its own spend and limit. Empty uses OPENROUTER_MANAGEMENT_KEY, then OPENROUTER_API_KEY, then the macOS Keychain item openrouter-key.
